#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

long long go(int n, int h, vector<vector<long long>>& dp) {
    if (n == 0) return 1;
    if (h == 0) return 0;
    if (dp[n][h] != -1) return dp[n][h];
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        sum += go(i, h-1, dp) * go(n-1-i, h-1, dp);
    }
    dp[n][h] = sum;
    return sum;
}

int main() {
    int n, h;
    cin >> n >> h;
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(n+1, vector<long long>(n+1, -1));
    long long result = go(n, n, dp) - go(n, max(0, h-1), dp);
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
